his_statement: Enveloping group and Lie algebra of the dual extension.
statement: For a p-divisible group G over a perfect characteristic-p field, the enveloping extension is interpreted as its universal vector extension: its vector kernel is the group associated to ω_(G*), denoted V(t_(G*)) in the manuscript’s vector-group convention. Its Lie sequence is 0→ω_(G*)→LieE(G)→LieG→0; the dual gives 0→ω_G→D(G)_k→LieG*→0. No finite-type representability of the whole p-divisible sheaf is asserted.
computation: No numerical computation. Source and proof-scope check recorded in check_events.tsv.
fate: Illusie, Pisa 2015, pp. 16–17 explains the universal-extension route and Messing’s crystalline construction; Berthelot–Messing 1979, §2 and §5 provide the later cohomological and duality framework.
